blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Search agents enable Large Language Models (LLMs) to iteratively retrieve and use information for complex multi-hop questions. Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) offers a promising approach for post-training such agents, but its reliance on sparse, outcome-based supervision can make credit assignment difficult and limit learning efficiency. In this paper, we systematically investigate how intermediate supervision can improve reinforcement learning for search agents. We study a range of reward-shaping and credit-assignment strategies that provide learning signals from intermediate retrieval steps. Building on these insights, we develop a training framework that combines intermediate signals with final outcome rewards to improve learning from multi-step search trajectories. Experiments across multiple benchmarks under matched training conditions demonstrate improvements in aggregate search-agent performance and show that both the choice of intermediate signal and where its credit is assigned affect training behaviour. These findings show that reward design and credit assignment are important design dimensions for training effective search agents.
blocks.zh: 搜索代理使"大语言模型"(LLMs)能够迭代地检索和使用信息处理复杂的多跳问题. 以可核实的奖励加强学习为此类人员培训后提供了一个很有希望的办法,但其依赖的是以成果为基础的零散监督会使信贷分配变得困难并限制了学习效率。 在本文中,我们系统地调查中间监督如何能改善搜索人员的强化学习. 我们研究了一系列的奖励-塑造和信用分配战略,从中间检索步骤中提供学习信号。 在这些洞察力的基础上,我们开发了一个将中间信号与最终结果奖励相结合的培训框架,以改进从多步骤搜索轨迹的学习. 在相应培训条件下进行的跨越多个基准的实验表明,搜索代理商的总体性能有所改善,并表明中间信号的选择及其功劳分配都影响到培训行为。 这些调查结果表明,奖励设计和信用分配是培训有效搜索人员的重要设计层面。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) allows large language models to answer questions using external evidence. For complex questions, the required evidence may be spread across several documents, and an initial retrieval may reveal what the model needs to search for next. Search agents such as Search-o1 ( Li et al., 2025a ) address this problem by interleaving reasoning with retrieval, using each observation to guide subsequent actions. Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025b ) and ReSearch ( Chen et al., 2025 ) use reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to train this behaviour from answer feedback. Through interaction with a search environment, the policy learns which queries to issue and how to use the returned information to answer the question.
blocks.zh: 检索-增强生成(RAG)(Lewis等,2020年)允许大型语言模型使用外部证据来回答问题. 对于复杂的问题,所需证据可能分布在多份文件中,初步检索可能揭示模型需要寻找的下一步。 Search-o1(Li等,2025a)等搜索代理通过将推理与检索相衔接来解决这个问题,利用每一项观察来指导后续行动. Search-R1(Jin等,2025b)和ReSearch(Chen等,2025)使用可核查奖励的强化学习(RLVR)从回答反馈中来训练这种行为. 通过与搜索环境的互动,政策学习了哪些问题要问,以及如何使用返回的信息回答问题。

blocks.en: A final outcome reward, however, provides limited information about the searches along the way. Two trajectories can both receive zero answer reward even though one retrieves part of the required evidence and the other retrieves none. When all rollouts in a question group receive the same answer score, group-relative training supplies no outcome advantage, leaving differences in retrieval progress unused. Intermediate supervision can make this progress available to the learner before it produces a correct final answer. Yet a retrieval score alone does not specify how to update the policy: the same evidence gain can change the reward for the whole trajectory or provide credit to the particular search that produced it.
blocks.zh: 然而,最后结果的奖励对沿途的搜索提供了有限的信息。 两道道道既可得到零答赏,即使一道道取出部分所需证据,而一道道道取出无. 当一个问题组中的所有推出都得到相同的回答分数时,分组相对的训练没有结果优势,使得检索进度的差异没有被利用. 中级监督可以使学习者在得出正确的最终答案之前获得这一进展。 然而,单凭检索分数并不能说明如何更新政策:同样的证据收益可以改变整个轨迹的回报,或者为产生它的特定搜索提供信用.

blocks.en: We therefore investigate how intermediate retrieval supervision depends on its credit assignment. We study two connected choices: what retrieved information should earn a reward, and how that reward should enter the policy update. A search can retrieve a fact before finding the evidence needed to establish its prerequisites. Rewarding that fact immediately recognises evidence already acquired, while waiting for its prerequisites rewards progress through the annotated dependency structure. These choices can assign credit to different searches even when the agent eventually retrieves the same evidence. Adding that credit to the final reward changes the shared advantage for the whole trajectory, whereas assigning it locally changes the update on a particular search action. Comparing retrieval signals under both formulations lets us examine whether a signal’s benefit persists across these choices.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们调查中间检索监督如何取决于其信贷分配。 我们研究两个相互关联的选择:哪些检索到的信息应获得奖励,以及该奖励应如何输入政策更新。 在找到确立其先决条件所需的证据之前,搜查可以取出一个事实。 立即奖励这一事实,承认已经获得的证据,同时等待其先决条件,通过附加说明的依赖结构来奖励进展。 这些选择可以给不同的搜索分配信用,即使代理最终取回了相同的证据. 将这一功劳加到最后的奖励中会改变整个轨迹的共享优势,而将其分配给当地则会改变特定搜索动作的更新. 比较两种措辞下的检索信号,让我们可以检查这些选择中是否存在信号的好处。

blocks.en: To support this study, we develop a data construction pipeline that composes corpus-grounded relations into questions while retaining intermediate answers, supporting passages and evidence dependencies. The intermediate answers and supporting passages identify which subquestions a retrieval helps answer, while the dependency structure records how those subquestions connect. Retaining both lets us change the rule for crediting evidence while holding the questions and their grounding fixed. The same annotations also support analysis of what a trained agent retrieves, separately from whether its final answer is correct.
blocks.zh: 为支持这项研究,我们开发了一个数据构建管道,将事实关系编成问题,同时保留中间答案、支持段落和证据依赖。 中间答案和辅助段落确定哪个子问题有助于检索,而依赖结构则记录这些子问题是如何连接的. 保留这两条,让我们改变证据的信用规则,同时保留问题并固定其立足点。 同一说明还支持分析训练有素的特工获取什么,以及其最终答案是否正确。

blocks.en: Using these annotations, we compare three retrieval signals on the same observations. Grounded evidence coverage (Cov) measures how much of the annotated evidence has been retrieved; coverage with dependencies (Cov-Dep) requires the same evidence to satisfy prerequisite relations; answer match (AM) checks for a reference answer in the retrieved text. Each signal supplies either a scalar reward bonus or a local, group-relative advantage alongside the final outcome reward (Figure 1 ). Within local credit, we further test whether feedback needs to remain aligned with its source search and whether its benefit is concentrated in groups with tied outcome rewards.
blocks.zh: 利用这些说明,我们比较了相同观测上的三个检索信号. 依据证据覆盖面(Cov)衡量附加说明的证据被取回多少;对依赖性(Cov-Dep)的涵盖需要同样的证据来满足先决条件关系;对检索文本中参考答案的回答匹配(AM)检查. 每个信号要么提供分级奖励奖金,要么在最后结果奖励的同时提供当地,集团相对的优势(图一. 在当地信贷范围内,我们进一步检验反馈是否需要与源头搜索保持一致,其收益是否集中在有附带结果回报的群体。

blocks.en: We evaluate these choices with Qwen3-4B across seven QA benchmarks. Both scalar and local retrieval supervision improve on outcome-only training, with local credit giving the largest gains. Cov-local improves average F1 by 3.09, with a larger gain of 4.81 on multi-hop QA. Our controlled comparisons further show that the effectiveness of a retrieval signal depends on how its credit is incorporated and whether it remains aligned with the action that produced it. These results show that retrieval rewards should be designed together with the way their credit enters the policy update.
blocks.zh: 我们通过Qwen3-4B在7个质量保证基准中评估这些选择。 scalar和地方检索监督都改进了只注重结果的培训,当地信贷收益最大。 Cov-local平均改善F1乘以3.09,在多跳QA上收获4.81. 我们的控制比较进一步表明,检索信号的有效性取决于其信用如何纳入,以及是否与产生信号的行动保持一致。 这些结果表明,检索奖励应结合其信用进入政策更新的方式来设计。

blocks.en: We further compare Cov-local with outcome-only training on annotated development questions. Cov-local retrieves more supporting evidence, while the two policies show similar coverage-conditioned answer F1. This suggests that the main change lies in evidence acquisition.

blocks.en: 2.1 Training data and evidence annotations
blocks.zh: 2.1 培训数据和证据说明

blocks.en: To evaluate intermediate retrieval during training, we construct questions together with their supporting evidence. A final answer alone cannot identify which intermediate facts a search has recovered. Our construction therefore preserves the subquestions, their dependencies and their source passages alongside each question, providing annotations for retrieval supervision as well as outcome evaluation. Following MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) in composing questions with dependent reasoning steps, we begin with entity pairs that co-occur within a KILT sentence and are linked by a Wikidata relation ( Vrandečić and Krötzsch, 2014 ) . We retain the source passage for each relation, allowing the evidence to be traced back to Wikipedia as relations are combined into questions.
blocks.zh: 为了评估培训期间的中间检索情况,我们把问题及其证明证据放在一起。 仅靠最后的答案无法确定搜索发现的中间事实。 因此,我们的构思保留了子问题、其依赖性以及每个问题的出处,为检索监督和结果评估提供了说明。 继MuSiQue(Trivedi等,2022年)用依赖性推理步骤编组问题后,我们先从KILT句子内同构并用维基数据关系连接的实体对开始(Vrandečić和克勒茨克,2014年). 我们保留了每个关系的源段落,允许将证据追溯到维基百科,因为关系被组合成问题.

blocks.en: We compose these relations into chains and conjunctive structures. For chains, we favour relation types that usually map a subject to one object, and require each selected subject–property pair to have exactly one object. This object can then serve as the subject of a subsequent step. For conjunctive structures, each branch must admit multiple candidates while their intersection identifies a single answer. Within the selected relations, neither branch alone determines the answer, so their combination adds a constraint rather than repeating an already sufficient relation. The resulting decomposition forms a graph in which each node represents a subquestion with its own answer, and directed edges record dependencies on earlier answers. A node can therefore require evidence from multiple passages. For example, “Which university did both person A and person B attend?” combines two education relations into one subquestion. We attach both supporting passages to this node, whereas a node representing a single relation retains that relation’s source passage.
blocks.zh: 我们把这些关系编成连锁和连锁结构。 对于链条,我们倾向于通常将一个对象映射在一个对象上的关系类型,并且要求每个被选中的主题 - 财产配对有一个对象。 此对象随后可作为后一步骤的主题. 对于交接结构,每个分支必须接纳多个候选人,而其交叉点则确定一个单一的答案. 在所选关系内,没有哪个分支单独决定答案,所以它们的组合会增加一个约束,而不是重复一个已经足够的关系. 由此产生的分解形成一个图表,其中每个节点代表一个带有自己答案的子问题,而定向边缘记录依赖于更早的答案. 因此,节点可以要求多个段落提供证据. 例如,“哪所大学的A和B都上过学?” 将两个教育关系合并为一个分问题。 我们把两个支持段落都附在这个节点上,而代表单一关系的节点则保留了该关系的源段落.

blocks.en: Once the structure is selected, GPT-5.6 Luna generates a descriptive reference for each root entity without naming it. Templates use these references and the selected relations to assemble the question, reference answer aliases, subquestions and dependency edges. The graph determines the answer and decomposition; the generated description supplies a way to refer to the starting entity in the question. For each subquestion, we also record the locations of its supporting passages and annotate mentions of its answer within them. These locations connect the generated question to the retriever’s chunks: a node is covered when retrieved chunks match all of its required passages. The graph edges specify which earlier answers a subquestion depends on, while the attached passages specify the evidence needed to answer it. Both coverage signals below use these annotations; answer match uses only the original question’s reference answer aliases.
blocks.zh: 一旦结构被选中,GPT-5.6 Luna生成每个根实体的描述性引用而无需命名. 模板使用这些引用和所选关系来集合问题,参考答案别名,子问题和依赖边. 图表决定答案并分解;生成的描述提供了一种在问题中指代起步实体的方法. 对于每个分问题,我们也记录其支持段落的位置,并在其中注明答案。 这些地点将产生的问题与检索器的块连接起来:当检索到的块与所有所需的段落相匹配时,一个节点就会被覆盖。 图表边缘指定了哪个先回答一个子问题所依赖,而所附段落则指定了答案所需的证据. 以下两个覆盖信号都使用这些说明;答案匹配只使用原题的参考答案别名.

blocks.en: We then exclude records with missing grounding, detected graph shortcuts, or unmatched structural categories, and sample deterministically from ten categories covering single-evidence, conjunctive, chain, and fan-in questions. This produces 14,000 training questions shared by all conditions. The training mixture contains 2,500 one-hop, 3,300 two-hop, 4,900 three-hop and 3,300 four-hop questions, grouped by their construction templates. The one-hop subset includes 1,200 single-evidence and 1,300 conjunctive questions; the remaining questions comprise 5,400 chain, 1,600 wide and 4,500 fan-in structures. The mixture therefore includes both sequential dependencies and evidence combined across branches. These categories describe annotated structures, not the number of searches an agent must execute.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们将缺失的地基记录、检测到的图表快捷键或无法匹配的结构类别以及确定样本从10个类别中排除,这些类别涵盖单一证据、连通性、链条和扇入性问题。 由此产生了14 000个所有条件共有的培训问题。 培训混合物包含2 500个一跳、3 300个二跳、4 900个三跳和3 300个四跳问题,按其建筑模板分类。 一跳子集包括1200个单一证据和1300个接合问题;其余问题包括5 400个链条、1 600个宽和4 500个扇形结构。 因此,混合物既包括依次依次依次依赖,也包括跨分支结合的证据。 这些类别描述附加说明的结构,而不是代理执行的搜索次数.

blocks.en: Retaining both passage-level evidence and dependencies lets us score the same retrieved observations with or without prerequisite constraints, while holding the questions and grounding fixed. We also reserve a separate set of annotated questions for the evidence-coverage analysis in Section 5.3 . The construction therefore supports both reward comparisons and analysis of search behaviour. 1 1 1 Appendix B provides construction constraints, mixture counts, and details of passage matching and grounding checks.

blocks.en: We further conduct controlled comparisons within the local formulation to examine event--action correspondence and which outcome groups benefit from retrieval credit. First, the permutation conditions test whether retrieval credit needs to remain aligned with the action that produced it. They shuffle nonzero signed event masses across rollouts for the same question at the same search step, preserving the available credit while breaking event--action correspondence. Second, the outcome-group restrictions test whether local credit is useful mainly when the outcome reward cannot distinguish trajectories. For both Cov and AM, flat-only retains local credit only in groups with tied answer scores, where the outcome advantage is zero; no-flat retains it only in groups with differing scores. Both retain the outcome advantage and leave the remaining local updates unscaled. These restrictions therefore compare where local credit is applied while also reducing its total amount. 2 2 2 Appendix A gives signal-matching rules, eligibility and normalisation checks, and details of permutation and outcome-group gating.

blocks.en: We train Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) on the same 14,000 questions. The searchable corpus is the KILT-2019 Wikipedia corpus ( Petroni et al., 2021 ) , partitioned into over 29 million 100-word chunks. Retrieval uses E5-base-v2 ( Wang et al., 2022 ) and returns three chunks per query. The retriever remains fixed during policy optimisation. Training uses GRPO with five rollouts per question and the same training budget across conditions. The outcome reward is answer F1, r i = F1 ⁡ ( y i , y ∗ ) r_{i}=\mathrm{F1}(y_{i},y^{*}) . Our baseline, outcome-only training (OO), uses this reward without retrieval supervision. All conditions share the clipped policy objective and KL regularisation, differing only in the reward or token advantage supplied to the objective. Group standardisation uses the sample standard deviation with ϵ = 10 − 6 \epsilon=10^{-6} . All results use the final checkpoint and greedy decoding. Appendix A gives the remaining settings.

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that local incorporation outperforms scalar incorporation for each retrieval signal, with the largest gain for evidence coverage. Cov-local achieves 54.34 average F1, compared with 51.25 for outcome-only training. All three scalar variants also improve over OO, but assigning credit locally yields further gains whose size depends on the retrieval signal. The signal ranking also changes: Cov is strongest under local incorporation, whereas Cov-Dep is strongest under scalar incorporation.

blocks.en: Comparing Cov with Cov-Dep shows how dependency constraints affect scalar and local training differently. Both use the same evidence nodes and grounding, but Cov credits a newly covered node before its prerequisites are retrieved. Removing dependency closure raises local F1 from 52.96 to 54.34, whereas scalar F1 changes from 52.82 to 52.64 (Figure 3 a). The two formulations use retrieval events differently: scalar incorporation sums them before group normalisation, while local incorporation compares them at each search step. Even when two event sequences end at the same coverage, they can produce different local updates. This distinction helps explain why signal construction must be considered together with incorporation.
blocks.zh: 将Cov与Cov-Dep相比较,可看出依赖性限制如何不同地影响斯卡尔和地方培训。 两者都使用相同的证据节点并打地基,但Cov在取回一个新覆盖的节点的先决条件之前,先贷记入该节点. 取消依赖性关闭使当地F1从52.96升至54.34,而Scalar F1则从52.82升至52.64(图3a)。 两种配方使用不同的检索事件:在组态正常化之前先用平面吸收,而本地吸收则在每个搜索步骤上加以比较。 即使两个事件序列在同一覆盖区结束,它们也可以产生不同的局部更新. 这种区分有助于解释为什么必须结合并入来考虑信号构造。

Cov-local has a larger advantage on multi-hop QA, while AM-local slightly exceeds it on single-hop QA. The benefit of local incorporation nevertheless depends on the signal and task group. Cov-Dep-local improves over its scalar counterpart on multi-hop QA but falls below it on single-hop QA. blocks.en: 5.1 Preserving action correspondence improves local credit
blocks.zh: 5.1 保留行动函证改善当地信用

blocks.en: Local credit links a search action to the evidence it retrieves. We test whether this link matters by comparing aligned credit with permuted credit for both Cov and AM. In the aligned condition, each eligible search receives the credit computed from its own retrieval event. In the permuted condition, we shuffle nonzero signed event masses across rollouts for the same question at the same search step. Credit still applies to query tokens, and the shuffle preserves the signed event masses; it changes which search receives each credit.
blocks.zh: 当地信用将搜索行动与它获取的证据联系起来. 我们通过比较Cov和AM两地的一致信贷和长期信贷来检验这种联系是否重要。 在对齐的条件下,每个合格的搜索都从自己的检索活动中获得计算出的信用。 在一个永久状态下,我们在同一搜索步骤上 将非零签名的事件群 展开同样的问题。 信用仍然适用于查询符,而shuffle保留了已签名的事件群;它会改变每次收到信用的搜索对象.

The advantage is larger on multi-hop QA than on single-hop QA. This pattern suggests that associating feedback with the search that produced it is particularly useful when answering a question requires several pieces of evidence.
blocks.zh: 图3b显示,两个信号的一致信用表现均超过渗透信用,Cov的平均F1增加了2.12个,AM增加了3.12个。 多跳QA的优势大于单跳QA. 这种模式表明,在回答一个问题需要若干证据时,将反馈与所产生的搜索联系起来特别有用。

blocks.en: Compared with OO, Cov-permute still achieves higher F1 (52.22 versus 51.25), while AM-permute performs worse (50.39). Coverage supervision therefore retains some benefit even when credit is reassigned, but preserving the correspondence raises F1 further to 54.34. For both signals, assigning credit to its source search is more effective than randomly reassigning it among searches.
blocks.zh: 与OO相比,Cov-permute仍然实现了更高的F1(52.22比 51.25),而AM-permute的性能更差(50.39). 因此,即使信贷被重新分配,保险范围监督仍保留一些好处,但保留通信将F1提高到54.34。 对于这两个信号,给其源代码搜索分配信用比在搜索中随机再分配更有效.

blocks.en: 5.2 Restricting local credit to outcome ties limits its benefit
blocks.zh: 5.2 将当地信贷限制在成果关系之内限制了其利益

blocks.en: For both Cov and AM, we compare local credit applied to all rollout groups with flat-only, which retains it only in groups with tied answer scores, and no-flat, which retains it only in groups with differing scores.
blocks.zh: 对Cov和AM来说,我们比较所有推出组都应用的本地信用和只使用平分的信用,这只保留在有平分答题分数的组中,没有平分,只保留在分数不同的组中.

blocks.en: For both signals, using all groups gives the highest aggregate F1, followed by no-flat and then flat-only (Figure 3 c). For Cov, excluding tied-outcome groups reduces F1 by 0.32, whereas retaining only those groups reduces it by 2.27. AM follows the same ordering, with losses of 1.44 and 2.19, respectively. Thus useful retrieval supervision is not confined to groups where the outcome reward cannot distinguish trajectories. Cov-flat-only remains above OO, while AM-flat-only performs similarly to OO. Both restrictions reduce the amount of local credit as well as changing which groups receive it.
blocks.zh: 对于这两种信号,使用所有组都给出了最高的总和F1,然后是无平面并再是平面(图3 c). 对Cov来说,不包括带结结果组将F1减少0.32,而只保留这些组将减少2.27。 AM遵循同样的订单,损失分别为1.44和2.19. 因此,有益的检索监督并不限于结果奖励无法区分轨迹的群体。 Cov-平面-仅保留在OO上方,而AM-平面-仅保留与OO相似的功能. 这两项限制都减少了当地信贷的数额并改变了哪些群体获得信贷。

blocks.en: 5.3 Evidence acquisition
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 取证

blocks.en: We compare OO and Cov-local on the same 1,200 synthetic development questions using the benchmark evaluation settings. The grounded annotations let us measure how much of the required evidence each policy retrieves. Figure 5 also plots answer F1 conditional on coverage for each policy. Appendix A.5 describes the trajectory analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们利用基准评价环境,将OO和Cov-local在同一1,200个综合发展问题上进行比较。 依据说明,让我们衡量每项政策获得多少必要证据。 图5还以每项政策涵盖范围为条件对F1作出回答。 附录A.5介绍了轨迹分析。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Final coverage distribution for OO and Cov-local on the same 1,200 development questions. Bars give the number of questions at each Cov value.
blocks.zh: 图 4: OO和Cov-local在同一1,200个发展问题上的最后覆盖分布。 条以每个 Cov 值给出问题数.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Mean answer F1 at each final Cov value. Each policy is grouped separately, so the curves can contain different question IDs at the same coverage.
blocks.zh: 图5:每个Cov最终值的平均回答F1。 每个策略都单独分类,因此曲线可以包含相同覆盖度的不同问题ID.

blocks.en: Across both policies, higher evidence coverage is associated with higher answer F1 (Figure 5 ), linking the retrieval signal to answer quality. Figure 5 shows that local coverage supervision shifts more questions towards higher evidence coverage. Cov-local reduces the number of zero-coverage questions from 616 to 551 and increases complete coverage from 142 to 167 questions. More questions therefore acquire annotated evidence, including the full set of required passages, although complete coverage remains uncommon.
blocks.zh: 在这两项政策中,更高的证据覆盖面与更高的回答F1(图5)有关,将检索信号与回答质量联系起来。 图5显示,地方覆盖监督将更多的问题转向更高的证据覆盖。 Cov-local将零覆盖问题的数量从616个减少到551个,并将完整的覆盖范围从142个增加到167个. 因此,更多的问题需要附加说明的证据,包括全套所需段落,尽管完全涵盖的范围仍然罕见。

blocks.en: Mean Cov increases from 27.51% under OO to 31.97% under Cov-local. The policies average 2.45 and 2.55 searches per question, respectively.
blocks.zh: 平均值 Cov从OO的27.51%增加到Cov-local的31.97%. 平均政策是每问题2.45个和2.55个。

blocks.en: The two Cov–F1 curves follow a similar overall pattern: at the same coverage level, Cov-local does not consistently achieve higher F1. Together with the coverage distribution, this suggests that query-level supervision primarily improves evidence acquisition, with less indication of improved use of the retrieved evidence. The groups at each coverage level differ in both size and question identity, so the curves do not isolate evidence use on the same questions. Further work could examine whether supervision beyond search queries improves how agents use retrieved evidence.
blocks.zh: 两道Cov-F1曲线遵循了类似的总体模式:在相同的覆盖水平上,Cov-local不能一贯地实现更高的F1. 与覆盖面分布一起,这表明查询一级的监督主要能改进证据的获取,较少显示对所取证据的利用有所改善。 每个覆盖层的组在大小和问题身份上都有所不同,因此曲线不会将相同问题上的证据使用隔离. 进一步的工作可以审查除查询之外的监督是否改善了特工人员如何使用所取取出的证据。

blocks.en: 6 Related work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: RAG ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) combines language generation with evidence from an external corpus. Multi-turn agents extend this interaction by deciding what to retrieve as reasoning proceeds. ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) provides a general framework for interleaving reasoning and actions. Search-o1 ( Li et al., 2025a ) integrates search into the reasoning process to retrieve missing knowledge. Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025b ) and ReSearch ( Chen et al., 2025 ) train search behaviour with reinforcement learning and answer feedback. An empirical study by Jin et al. (2025a) reports limited gains from intermediate retrieval rewards in the settings examined. We study how their effectiveness depends on the way retrieval credit enters the policy update.
blocks.zh: RAG(Lewis等,2020年)结合了语言生成和由外体出的证据. 多转子代理通过决定作为推理过程回收什么来扩展这种相互作用. ReAct (Yao等, 2023)为离间推理和行动提供了一个总的框架. Search-o1 (Li等,2025a.)将搜索整合到推理过程中来取回缺失的知识. Search-R1 (Jin等,2025b)和ReSearch (Chen等,2025)的列车搜索行为有强化学习并回答反馈. Jin等人(2025年a)的一项实证研究报告称,在所审查的环境下,中间检索奖励的收益有限。 我们研究它们的效力如何取决于检索信贷如何进入政策更新。

blocks.en: Lightman et al. (2024) study process supervision for mathematical reasoning, providing feedback on intermediate steps rather than only the final result. For retrieval, R3-RAG ( Li et al., 2025b ) combines answer correctness with document-relevance rewards. SWiRL ( Goldie et al., 2025 ) decomposes multi-step reasoning and tool-use trajectories into action-level sub-trajectories for data filtering and RL optimisation. More recent search-agent methods assess different aspects of retrieval progress. HiPRAG ( Wu et al., 2026 ) evaluates search necessity and adds a hierarchical process bonus to outcome and format rewards. BiCAA ( Huang et al., 2026 ) combines forward answer-solvability gains with hindsight estimates of a search step’s importance for the final answer. Our study uses corpus-grounded annotations to compare answer matching with evidence coverage. The two coverage variants share their grounding and differ in whether prerequisite relations constrain credit, allowing us to trace that choice through the resulting updates.
blocks.zh: Lightman等 (2024)研究数学推理过程监督,提供中间步骤的反馈,而不仅仅是最终结果. 为了检索,R3-RAG(Li等,2025b.)将回答正确性与文档相关性奖励结合起来. SWiRL(Goldie等,2025年)将多步推理和工具使用轨迹分解为动作级子导出,用于数据过滤和RL优化. 最近搜索代理方法评估了检索进度的不同方面。 HiPRAG(Wu等,2026年)评价搜索必要性,并在结果和格式奖励上增加分级流程奖金. BiCAA (Huang等, 2026) 结合了前置答案-可解性增益和后置估计搜索步骤对最终答案的重要性. 我们的研究使用基于物证的说明 比较答案和证据的覆盖。 两种覆盖范围的变体有着共同的基础,在前提条件关系是否限制信用方面有所不同,使我们能够通过由此产生的更新来追踪这一选择。

blocks.en: An intermediate signal also requires a rule for assigning credit to the policy. STAMP ( Xu et al., 2026 ) verifies cited evidence against a reference graph, attributes it to the action that first exposed it, and modulates the outcome advantage without changing its sign. GDCR ( Liu et al., 2026 ) rewards newly retrieved and cited entities according to their graph distance to the answer; SAPO standardises these rewards across steps within each trajectory and scales their contribution by the absolute outcome advantage. CW-GRPO ( Wang et al., 2026 ) uses an LLM judge to assess retrieval utility and reasoning correctness, redistributing outcome advantage across successful search rounds while assigning uniform weights to failed trajectories.
blocks.zh: 中间信号还要求有一条规则,用于向政策分配信贷。 STAMP(Xu等,2026年)对照参考图表验证所引用的证据,将其归属于首次被曝光的动作,并调节结果优势而未改变其标志. GDCR(Liu等,2026年)根据新检索和被引用的实体与答案的相距来奖励;SAPO根据绝对结果优势来规范每个轨迹内的各个步骤的这些奖励,并衡量其贡献。 CW-GRPO(Wang等,2026年)使用LLM法官来评估检索的效用和推理的正确性,在成功搜索回合之间重新分配结果优势,同时为失败的轨迹分配统一的权重.

blocks.en: These methods scale intermediate credit by the outcome advantage. We compare retrieval events across rollouts of the same question at the same search step and add the resulting signed residual to selected tokens. When eligible events vary, this residual can remain active at zero outcome advantage and can reverse a nonzero advantage. Our experiments examine whether its source action and activation on tied-outcome groups affect performance. The scalar comparison also shows that learning from outcome ties is shared by both forms of intermediate supervision (Appendix A.4 ).
blocks.zh: 这些方法以结果优势衡量中间信用。 我们在同一搜索步骤上比较同一问题推出过程中的检索事件,并将由此产生的签名后剩余部分添加到选定的信使上。 当符合条件的事件不同时,这种剩余物可以以零结果优势保持活性,并可以逆转非零优势. 我们的实验研究了它的源动和激活 绑定结果组是否影响性能。 平面比较还表明,从结果关系中学习是两种形式的中间监督共同的(附录A.4).

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: Our analysis examines evidence acquisition and retrieval credit. A further question is how retrieved evidence enters subsequent reasoning. This requires tracing evidence use through intact search trajectories, including cases where additional coverage does not change the answer. Such an analysis could inform supervision that connects evidence acquisition with evidence use.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析审查了证据的获取和检索信用。 另一个问题是,如何将收回的证据纳入随后的推理。 这就需要通过完整无缺的搜索轨迹来追踪证据的使用,包括额外覆盖不会改变答案的情况。 这种分析可以为监督提供依据,监督将取证与证据的使用联系起来。

blocks.en: The interaction between reward construction and update strength also warrants closer study. Experiments that vary event timing, reward magnitude and credit eligibility independently could distinguish their contributions, while comparisons under matched update strength could clarify the role of normalisation in scalar and local incorporation. Extending these controls across model sizes and retrievers would test whether these credit-assignment behaviours generalise.
blocks.zh: 奖励建设与更新实力之间的互动也值得更仔细地研究. 独立地进行不同活动时间、奖励规模和信用资格的实验,可以区分它们的贡献,而根据相应的更新强度进行比较,可以澄清正常化在平面和本地注册方面的作用。 将这些控制扩大到模型大小和检索器,将检验这些信用分配行为是否普遍。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: Our study shows that intermediate retrieval supervision should be designed together with its credit assignment. Using corpus-grounded questions with intermediate evidence annotations, we find that the same retrieval signal has different effects depending on how it enters the policy update. Dependency constraints help distinguish this interaction: requiring prerequisites benefits scalar incorporation, while crediting evidence as it is acquired works better under local incorporation. A more constrained evidence signal therefore does not necessarily provide more useful supervision.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究表明,在设计中间检索监督时,应结合其信贷分配。 使用有中间证据说明的以物证为基础的问题,我们发现,同一个检索信号根据其进入政策更新的方式而产生不同的效果. 依赖性限制有助于区分这种相互作用:要求先决条件有利于规模化公司注册,同时将证据作为证据,因为在当地公司注册下获得的工作更好。 因此,较为受限的证据信号不一定提供更有用的监督。

blocks.en: Across our experiments, local retrieval credit is most effective when it remains associated with the search that produced the evidence and complements outcome supervision across both tied and differing outcome groups. Its value extends beyond supplying an update when answer rewards are tied. On the development questions, higher coverage and similar coverage-conditioned F1 suggest that local supervision primarily changes evidence acquisition, leaving evidence use as a separate question. Together, these findings support treating evidence scoring and action-level credit assignment as coupled design choices when training search agents.
blocks.zh: 在我们的试验中,如果当地检索信贷仍然与产生证据的搜索有关,并补充对附带条件和不同结果组的成果监督,那么这种信贷是最有效的。 其价值超越了提供答复奖励时的更新。 关于发展问题,更高的覆盖面和具有类似覆盖面条件的F1表明,地方监督主要改变证据的获取,将证据的使用作为一个单独问题。 这些调查结果共同支持在培训搜索人员时,将证据评分和行动一级信用分配作为组合设计选择。

blocks.en: Qwen3’s native tool interface supports parallel tool calling. We retain this interface and execute only the first query in each search call to keep the retrieval budget per call fixed across conditions. This controls an additional source of variation while we compare reward construction and credit assignment. The tool response reports any ignored queries, which can be issued in later turns. blocks.en: We use α = 0.25 \alpha=0.25 for all scalar conditions as a common trade-off between outcome reward and retrieval supervision. Both answer F1 and accumulated retrieval progress lie in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , so the retrieval bonus adds at most 0.25 to the combined reward. This allows retrieval progress to distinguish trajectories with similar answer scores while ensuring that an answer with F1 of one always outranks an answer with F1 of zero.
blocks.zh: 我们使用α = 0.25\alpha = 0.25 用于所有平面条件,作为结果奖励和检索监督之间的共同取舍。 回答F1和累积取回进度都位于[0, 1] [0, 1],因此取回奖金最多会给综合取出0.25分. 这使得检索进度可以区分答案分数相近的轨迹,同时确保一个答案中一个F1总是比一个答案中一个F1的分数为零.

blocks.en: A.5 Evaluation and trajectory measurements

blocks.en: The main evaluation contains 3,197 questions: six datasets with 512 questions each and Bamboogle with 125. Dataset-level EM and F1 scores are weighted by their sample counts, so each evaluation question contributes equally to Avg.

blocks.en: We evaluate OO and Cov-local on the same 1,200 synthetic development questions. For each question, we retain the sequence of assistant messages, search actions, tool observations and the final answer. We map retrieved text in complete visible tool observations to the original corpus chunks and apply the coverage predicate from Section 2 . Generated reasoning and answers do not contribute to coverage. For this analysis, we use the exact fraction of covered gold nodes rather than the rounded values used to construct training rewards. Figure 5 counts the questions at each covered-node proportion. We compute mean coverage and search count over all 1,200 questions. Figure 5 groups each policy’s questions separately by final Cov and averages answer F1 within each group; it does not filter for matched question IDs at a given coverage value.
blocks.zh: 我们评价OO和Cov-local的同一个1200个综合发展问题。 对于每个问题,我们保留了助理消息,搜索动作,工具观察和最后答案的顺序. 我们将检索到的文本以完整的可见工具观测到原物块,并应用第2节的覆盖上游。 由此产生的推理和答案无助于覆盖。 对于这一分析,我们使用覆盖的黄金节点的确切比例,而不是用来构建培训奖励的四舍五入值。 图5按覆盖点比例计算问题。 我们计算所有1200个问题的平均覆盖率和搜索数。 图5将每个政策的问题按最终Cov分类,平均数在每一组内分别回答F1;它没有按照特定覆盖值过滤匹配的问题ID。

blocks.en: All questions remain in the denominator, including missing answers and truncated trajectories. OO has 19 missing answers and 12 truncated trajectories; Cov-local has 20 and 16, respectively. One OO trajectory ends with an incomplete tool observation, which is excluded from coverage; executed searches still contribute to the search count. Search count measures tool use, rather than generation cost or wall-clock latency. As detailed in the data-construction appendix, 507 development questions share some annotated evidence with training, while 693 have fully unseen annotated evidence. This analysis examines behaviour on the development distribution separately from the seven-benchmark results.
blocks.zh: 所有问题都留在分母中,包括缺失的答案和短路. OO有19个缺失的答案和12个短道速滑;Cov-local分别有20个和16个. 一个OO轨迹以不完整的工具观察为结尾,它被排除在覆盖范围之外;已执行的搜索仍然有助于搜索计数. 搜索计数工具的使用,而不是生成成本或墙上时空. 如数据建设附录所详述,507个发展问题在培训中分享了一些附加说明的证据,693个问题则完全没有附加说明。 本分析从七分基准结果中分别审查开发分布的行为.

blocks.en: Appendix B Training data and corpus construction
blocks.zh: 附录B 培训数据及教程构建

blocks.en: We use the August 2019 KILT Wikipedia corpus and the August 2022 Wikidata truthy dump. For chain composition, we retain properties with at most 1.5 objects per subject on average, and require the selected subject–property pair to have exactly one object. For a conjunction, both branches must have multiple candidate objects and their intersection must contain exactly one. These constraints define the annotated graph structure. Relations are selected from corpus co-occurrences and filtered using Wikidata; each selected relation retains its supporting Wikipedia passage.
blocks.zh: 我们使用2019年8月的KILT维基百科和2022年8月的Wikidata Truthy dump. 对于链状成分,我们保留每个对象平均最多1.5个对象的属性,并要求选定的对象-财产对完全有一个对象. 对于组合,两个分支必须具有多个候选对象,它们的相交点必须包含一个完全的. 这些制约因素界定了附加说明的图表结构。 关系从实体共发中选择,并使用Wikidata过滤;每个被选择的关系保留其支持的维基百科段落.

blocks.en: We use GPT-5.6 Luna ( gpt-5.6-luna ) for root-description generation throughout the source pool. Graph operations and templates determine the question structure, answers and dependencies.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-5.6 Luna(gpt-5.6-luna),在整个源池进行根描述生成. 图形操作和模板决定了问题结构,答案和依赖性.

blocks.en: Several atomic nodes can share a supporting paragraph. We merge shared supporting paragraphs when assigning structural categories for sampling, while preserving the original atomic nodes and prerequisites used by Cov-Dep and Cov. The resulting categories describe annotated evidence structure rather than the agent’s search count. To map evidence to indexed chunks, we remove the page’s initial title entry, retain section and bullet marker lines, join the remaining text with newlines, and split it into non-overlapping 100-word chunks. Grounding normalises page and paragraph identifiers and locates answer mentions within these spans; the coverage rule in Section 2 also checks page identity.
blocks.zh: 几个原子节点可以共享一个支持段落. 我们在分配取样的结构类别时,合并了共享的支持段落,同时保留了Cov-Dep和Cov所用的原始原子节点和先决条件。 由此产生的类别描述的是附加说明的证据结构,而不是代理人的搜索计数。 为了将证据映射成索引块,我们删除了该页的初始标题条目,保留了部分和弹出标记线,用新行与所剩文字相接,并分成非重叠的100个字块。 确定正常的页和段落标识符,并在这些跨度内找到答案;第2节的覆盖规则还检查了页名。

blocks.en: We sample deterministically within each structural category, reserving 1,200 questions for the evidence-coverage analysis in Section 5.3 and selecting 14,000 training questions from the remainder. We refer to the reserved questions as the development split. Of 87,171 source questions, 86,681 are eligible: 168 fail the chunk-grounding eligibility check, 297 are labelled graph shortcuts by the construction filter, and 25 do not match a requested category. For the first four categories, half the selected records have all gold evidence in the first chunk of each supporting page and half require later chunks. Other categories are sampled from their full eligible pools.
blocks.zh: 我们在每个结构类别中进行确定性抽样,在第5.3节中保留1 200个问题用于证据覆盖分析,并从其余部分选择14 000个培训问题。 我们把保留的问题称为发展分裂。 在87,171个源问题中,86,681个符合资格:168个未通过块基资格检查,297个被标注为构造过滤器的图表快捷键,25个不符合要求的类别. 就前四类而言,所选记录的一半在每个佐证页的第一分块中有所有黄金证据,而一半则需要后面的分块。 其他类别则取自其全部合格集合。

blocks.en: Table 4: Training and development counts by construction category. Structural labels follow the naming convention of MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) ; numbered suffixes distinguish graph templates at the same hop count. Categories account for shared supporting paragraphs and describe evidence structure, not search counts.
blocks.zh: 表4:按建筑类别分列的培训与发展数。 结构标签遵循了MuSiQue的命名惯例(Trivedi等,2022;编号后缀在同一hop计数中区分出图表模板. 共享辅助段落的分类账户,并描述证据结构,而不是搜索数。

blocks.en: Each record contains a question, answer aliases, a decomposition, dependency references, and corpus grounding. The selected data contain 44,385 graph nodes, including 8,050 conjunctive nodes. The retrieval index contains approximately 29 million chunks represented by normalised 768-dimensional embeddings. Every node is grounded in the corpus, every prerequisite refers to an existing node, and the dependency graphs are acyclic.
blocks.zh: 每一份记录都包含一个问题、答案和别名、分解、依赖性参考和实体依据。 所选数据包含44,385个图表节点,包括8,050个接合节点. 检索指数包含约2,900万个以正统的768维嵌入为代表的块. 每个节点都以本体为根基,每个先决条件都指一个已存在的节点,依赖图是循环的.

blocks.en: Each node stores a list of required source passages, identified by Wikipedia page and paragraph, and the character spans of its subquestion-answer mentions in each passage. For every required passage, the detector checks whether any retrieved chunk has the same page and paragraph and contains the start offset of at least one annotated mention. A node is covered only if this test succeeds for all of its required passages. Different passages may be matched by different chunks and at different search steps. Both Cov and Cov-Dep use this check; dependency closure is applied separately by Cov-Dep. The check does not require the entire answer mention or supporting sentence to fit inside the chunk, as quantified below.
blocks.zh: 每个节点都存储由维基百科页面和段落所识别的所需源段落列表,以及每个段落所提及其子问答的字符跨度. 对于每一需要的段落,探测器检查任何被检索的块是否有相同的页面和段落,并包含至少一个附加说明的引用的起始相抵. 一个节点只有在测试成功时才能覆盖,因为它的所有必要段落都成功. 不同的段落可能与不同的块相匹配,并在不同的搜索步骤相匹配. Cov和Cov-Dep都使用此检查;依赖关闭由Cov-Dep单独应用. 该检查不要求整个答案提及或支持句子在块内符合以下量化.

blocks.en: All 15,200 selected questions begin with the same “What is the name of” surface template. Normalised answer-alias strings occur in 57 training and 5 development questions. These matches include ordinary-word collisions and aliases embedded in longer names, as well as potential answer cues. There is no exact question-ID or normalised-question overlap between the two splits, but 225 development questions have all gold evidence seen in training and 282 have partial evidence overlap; only 693 have fully unseen gold evidence. The development split contains 531 questions sharing a training page and 606 sharing an answer entity. This split is reserved separately from the benchmark evaluation; the shared evidence limits its value for measuring generalisation.
blocks.zh: 所有15 200个选定的问题都以同样的“表层模板的名称”开头。 在57个培训和5个发展问题中,出现了正常化的回答别名串。 这些匹配包括嵌入较长名词的普通字相撞和别名,以及潜在的接应提示. 这两个分块之间没有确切的问题ID或常态化的问题重叠,但225个发展问题在训练中已经看到所有黄金证据,282个有部分证据重叠;只有693个完全没有黄金证据. 开发拆分包含共享培训页面的531个问题和共享答案实体的606个问题. 这种划分与基准评价分开;共享证据限制了其衡量通用性的价值。

blocks.en: All 52,435 gold annotation records have start-position coverage. For 265 records, no single chunk fully contains any of the annotated answer mentions. Across matched annotation–chunk pairs, 271 contain a mention’s start but no complete annotated mention. Chunk identification uses a text prefix, so identifying a chunk does not establish that its full text is present in the observation.
blocks.zh: 所有52,435个金币注解记录都有起跑位置覆盖. 对于265个记录,没有任何一个块完全包含任何附加说明的答案。 271 包含一个开头的注解, Chunk识别使用文本前缀,因此识别块并不能确定它的全部文本存在于观察中.

blocks.en: We verify graph validity and the alignment between evidence annotations and retriever chunks. Table 5 summarises these properties and the effects of chunk boundaries and dependency constraints on retrieval progress.
blocks.zh: 我们核实图表的有效性 以及证据说明和检索器块之间的一致 表5概括了这些属性以及块边界的影响和对检索进度的依赖性限制。

blocks.en: Table 5: Graph structure and chunk grounding in the training and development data, with retrieval-progress differences measured on 7,680 training trajectories.
blocks.zh: 表5:在培训和开发数据中采用图表结构和块块定位,在7 680个培训轨迹上测量检索与进度的差异。

blocks.en: The trajectory measurements use 7,680 training trajectories collected before the final-policy comparisons.
blocks.zh: 轨迹测量采用最终政策比较前收集的7,680个培训轨迹。

blocks.en: Table 5 shows how chunk boundaries and dependency constraints affect retrieval progress. Requiring the complete answer mention to fit within a retrieved chunk reduces Cov-Dep progress on 20 of the 7,680 trajectories. Dependency constraints affect which matched nodes receive credit: Cov exceeds Cov-Dep on 310 trajectories, while 21 contain evidence credited only after a later search retrieves its prerequisites.
blocks.zh: 表5显示块边界和依赖性制约如何影响检索进度。 在7,680个轨迹中的20个轨迹中,Cov-Dep的进展减少。 依赖性限制影响到相应的节点获得信贷: Cov在310道轨迹上超过了Cov-Dep,而21道存有在后期检索取回其先决条件后才能记取的证据.

blocks.en: Grounding determines whether a retrieved chunk matches an annotated node; closure determines when that match contributes to progress. The two checks affect the same reward at different stages.
blocks.zh: 定位决定一个被检索块是否与附加说明的节点相匹配;关闭则决定该匹配何时有助于进展 。 这两个检查在不同阶段影响同样的奖励。

blocks.en: The query-alignment contrasts are larger on multi-hop QA: Cov-local exceeds Cov-permute by 3.73 F1 on multi-hop QA and 0.39 F1 on single-hop QA; AM-local exceeds AM-permute by 4.75 and 1.35 F1, respectively. Correct correspondence therefore improves both task groups under both signals, with larger differences on multi-hop QA. All three scalar variants improve over OO in both task groups. Local incorporation further improves multi-hop QA for every signal, while on single-hop QA Cov-Dep-local falls below its scalar counterpart. The groups contain different benchmarks, so this comparison does not isolate the effect of question hop count.
blocks.zh: 多跳QA的查询-对齐对比较大: Cov-local 超过 Cov-permoute由多跳QA的3.73 F1和单跳QA的0.39 F1组成;AM-local分别以4.75和1.35 F1超过AM-permoute. 因此,正确的通信在两个信号下改进了两个任务组,在多跳QA上差异较大. 所有三种平面变体在两个工作组中都比OO有所改善。 本地化进一步提升了每个信号的多跳QA,而单跳QA Cov-Dep-local则会低于其斯卡拉克对应. 分组包含不同的基准,因此这种比较不会孤立出问题跳计的效果.

blocks.en: The question asks which dynasty the father of the Burmese monarch who ruled from 1171 to 1174 belonged to. The displayed rollout searches for Burma monarch 1171-1174 father king dynasty . Its first search returns passages titled Narathu, Naratheinkha and Saw Lu. The Naratheinkha passage matches the first annotated node, identifying the monarch from his reign; the Narathu passage matches the third node, identifying the dynasty. The second node requires a different passage establishing Naratheinkha’s father and remains unmatched. Thus the covered set is { v 1 , v 3 } \{v_{1},v_{3}\} , while dependency closure admits only { v 1 } \{v_{1}\} . The first-search potentials and events are both 0.6667 for Cov and 0.3333 for Cov-Dep, displayed as 0.67 and 0.33 in the figure. The matched dynasty fact is credited by Cov even though the intervening father link has not been retrieved.

blocks.en: Appendix E A paired example of evidence acquisition
blocks.zh: 附录E 证据获取的对等实例

blocks.en: Figure 8 compares the two policies on a question about Robert A. Rosenstone’s institution. OO’s first two searches return other scholars; its third retrieves an introductory passage that identifies Rosenstone and names Caltech. Cov-local retrieves that passage on its first search, then obtains an additional annotated career passage on its second. Both final answers are correct. The additional passage raises annotated coverage from one node to two, even though the introductory passage already contains the answer. This case illustrates the distinction between recovering an answer and covering the annotated evidence.
blocks.zh: 图8比较了关于罗伯特·罗森斯通机构问题的两项政策。 OO的前两次搜索让其他学者回归;其第三回检索了一条介绍性段落,该段落识别了罗森斯通和加州理工学院的名称. Cov-local在第一次搜索时检索了该通道,然后在第二次搜索时获得附加注释的职业通道. 最终两个答案都是正确的。 新增段落将附加说明的报道从一个节点增加到两个,尽管导言段落已经载有答案。 本案表明,收回一个答复与涵盖附加说明的证据之间有区别。

blocks.en: We select the first question in lexicographic ID order among complete multi-node pairs where Cov-local attains full annotated coverage, OO does not, and Cov-local executes fewer searches. Three pairs satisfy these criteria; correctness and F1 are not selection criteria. The figure retains the executed queries and final response text, with observation descriptions abridged against the original returned passages.
blocks.zh: 我们在全多节点对中选择词典标识顺序中的第一个问题,其中Cov-local实现全注解覆盖,OO不,Cov-local执行的搜索更少. 三对符合这些标准;正确性和F1不是选择标准. 图中保留了已执行的询问和最后答复文本,观察说明与原回回的段落相去甚远。
